about: Speed baselines and budgets for Polycarp's parts. Each section names the script or test that writes or checks it.

appLaunchToFirstFrame.how: live check on the Mac: log stream --predicate 'process == "Polycarp"' --style compact & open -a Polycarp, then read the time from the process start (ps -o lstart) to the first "welcome" or "started" line in Polycarp's trace.log

windowsSwitch.about: Win+n on a windows-latest runner, timed from SendInput until DWM reads all 30 swatch windows right (9 workspaces, 3 or 4 shown, the rest cloaked): platforms/windows/tests/ci/switch-bench.ps1, CI job spaces-windows-speed. It fails over p90Ms times regressionLimit (or p90Ms plus floorMs, whichever is more, since runners vary), and on its own fixed limits (p90 100 ms, p99 250 ms, the max only reported, an outside uncloak undone at p90 under 100 ms).

launcherRooms.about: The launcher's rooms (docs/rooms.md) on every keystroke: RoomsProvider.results and the room: filter, 2,000 queries of the kinds people type, in a debug build (BaneySpacesCore is not built -O). RoomsLauncherTests fails over p90BudgetMs, a sliver of the 16 ms a key press may take for every row (KeyPressCheck). Opening the launcher reads the root and lists the Inbox once; refreshMs is that with 500 items waiting, against the launcher's 60 ms p50 open budget below.

spacesTiming.about: Budgets in ms for every event kind Spaces writes to timing.log: switch (a switch between two workspaces, its done= mark), parked (the same switch's parked= mark), and each `open <kind>=` line (settings-pane is any `open settings-<pane>=`). scripts/speed-report.sh checks the last day of the real timing.log against them and exits 1 on a miss; SpeedBudgetTests fails when the app logs a kind with no budget here. A percentile is judged only with minSamples lines or more. measured is the owner's Mac, 2026-11-16 to 11-17 (council brief polycarp-mac.md); budgets are tightened from it toward the targets in the 2026-11-17 gap list (P1 to P5, X2), so today's log is expected to miss some.

tile.target: 8 windows, from the look to the last frame sent, under 50 ms of our own time

switcher.target: the ⌘Tab panel, from when it is asked to show
